Name: Mistlyn's Elliott Portrait
Author: Mistlyn
Description:
[b][u]Required Mods:[/u][/b]
- SMAPI
- Content Patcher
- Portraiture

[b][u]How to:[/u][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download the Portraiture mod, extract the file, and drag it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Open the Portraiture Mod folder: Portraiture/Portraits/, then create your own folder (name the folder whatever you want).
[*]Download this file, extract it, select the version you prefer, and drag the images into the folder you created.
[*]Run the game. You can apply images by pressing the "P" key.
[/list]
[b]Please read the installation guide carefully. If you have any questions or problems, feel free to ask me anytime.[/b]
